175412.overview: Elektro Storm is a clone of the Atari arcade classic, Missile Command. It was developed and published by Personal Software Services in 1983.

175624.overview: Encounter is a text adventure for the Oric 1/Oric Atmos computers. It was developed and published by Severn Software in 1983. Your task is to find and rescue a young girl kidnapped by thugs. Everything you need is here but you may have to manufacture some items. CLUE: Chemistry knowledge helps.
